name: presence-lock
title: Presence Lock
description: Presence UI that shows who is editing what ("Priya is editing Price"), softly locks that field in their colour with an "Edit anyway" that warns once, never locks someone already typing, and releases locks held by idle people. Transport-agnostic.

meta.stops: Two people editing the same field
meta.summary: Shows who is editing which field and softly locks it in their colour, so two people don't silently overwrite each other's edit.
meta.server: Use versioning or merge rules on save so a late write can't silently overwrite another.
catches: Two people editing the same field
Edit anyway: warns once before overriding
Locks held by people who went idle are released
Someone already typing is never locked out
limits: Soft lock only; your backend must handle conflicting saves
Presence comes from your transport; latency can show stale state
Idle detection depends on your heartbeats
a11y: Avatars are a labelled group; images have empty alt with names in titles
Joins and leaves are announced in a polite live region
A locked field is inert until Edit anyway
